title: DEBT102: a send writes its import file outside the store lock
note: A send plans and writes its import file, then takes the store lock to stamp. A copy that sells or is retired in that gap is skipped by the stamp, but its row is already in the file. A send never counts a copy it did not send, so the store never counts that copy sent (D26 (retired is a terminal card state); D59 (live count is per SKU)).
